$note: List prices used by scripts/deploy.* to itemise what a deployment will bill before it starts. These are USD pay-as-you-go retail prices for westus3 and they are an ESTIMATE, not a quote: your agreement, currency, region and reservations all change them. Every figure below was read from the public Azure retail price API and each entry records the exact query so you can re-check it yourself - no auth needed, see docs/costs.md.

azureFirewallStandard.label: Azure Firewall (Standard)
azureFirewallStandard.query: serviceName eq 'Azure Firewall' and skuName eq 'Standard'

azureFirewallPremium.label: Azure Firewall (Premium)
azureFirewallPremium.query: serviceName eq 'Azure Firewall' and skuName eq 'Premium'

bastionBasic.label: Azure Bastion (Basic)
bastionBasic.query: serviceName eq 'Azure Bastion' and skuName eq 'Basic'

dnsResolverEndpoint.label: DNS Private Resolver endpoint
dnsResolverEndpoint.countNote: inbound and outbound endpoints are billed separately

publicIp.label: Public IP (Standard, static)
publicIp.query: serviceName eq 'Virtual Network' and contains(meterName,'Standard IP')

aksUptimeSla.label: AKS Standard tier (uptime SLA)
aksUptimeSla.query: serviceName eq 'Azure Kubernetes Service' and skuName eq 'Standard'

aksAutomaticControlPlane.label: AKS Automatic hosted control plane
aksAutomaticControlPlane.plusUsage: about $0.01 per node hour on top of the VM price
aksAutomaticControlPlane.query: serviceName eq 'Azure Kubernetes Service' and skuName eq 'Automatic'

acrBasic.label: Container registry (Basic)
acrBasic.query: serviceName eq 'Container Registry' and skuName eq 'Basic'

acrStandard.label: Container registry (Standard)
acrStandard.query: serviceName eq 'Container Registry' and skuName eq 'Standard'

acrPremium.label: Container registry (Premium)
acrPremium.query: serviceName eq 'Container Registry' and skuName eq 'Premium'

grafanaStandard.label: Managed Grafana (Standard)
grafanaStandard.unitNote: one active node plus zone redundancy
grafanaStandard.plusUsage: $6 per user per month beyond the included editors

privateDnsZone.label: Private DNS zone
privateDnsZone.query: serviceName eq 'Azure DNS' and contains(meterName,'Private Zone')

logAnalyticsPerGb.label: Log Analytics ingestion
logAnalyticsPerGb.query: armRegionName eq 'westus3' and serviceName eq 'Log Analytics' and contains(meterName,'Ingestion')

defenderPerVcoreHour.label: Defender for Containers
defenderPerVcoreHour.query: contains(productName,'Defender for Containers') and skuName eq 'Standard vCore'

keyVaultStandard.label: Key Vault (Standard)
keyVaultStandard.query: serviceName eq 'Key Vault' and skuName eq 'Standard'
